segments.title: the objection from an unchanging karma

spans.tib: las dang de'i 'bras bu'i bar du yun ring por chod pa'i
spans.eng: the original karma and its eventual consequences may be separated by a very long period of time
virtuous and non-virtuous karma or actions
during the entire period up to the point
relationship where karma gave rise to any consequence

segments.note: English-first alignment by Codex, PROVISIONAL machine analysis. The opening temporal modifier is kept as a complete d3 recast so original and eventual are not falsely assigned to bare Tibetan words. Articles, repeated school nouns, rhetorical participants, and auxiliaries remain unlinked. The final karma-result relation is also kept whole because English changes result-arises-from-karma into karma-gave-rise-to-result; atomizing the verb would reverse causal roles. The closing mi 'thad is omitted rather than assigned to never because its judgment is distributed across could never have.
